purpose: Record that the legacy 0.028 eV runtime row now appears more consistent with a later nanomagnetic-memory benchmark branch than with the currently pinned Jun 2014 feedback-trap source identity.

current_pinned_source_identity.title: High-Precision Test of Landauer's Principle in a Feedback Trap
current_pinned_source_identity.claim_boundary: Jun 2014 remains the pinned feedback-trap source identity, but the legacy 0.028 eV runtime row is not currently trustworthy as a clean Jun-mapped quantity.

candidate_alternate_source_identity.title: Experimental test of Landauer's principle in single-bit operations on nanomagnetic memory bits
candidate_alternate_source_identity.secondary_summary_signal: about 0.026 eV at 300 K, roughly 44% above the Landauer minimum
candidate_alternate_source_identity.primary_facing_preprint_signal: same-author arXiv precursor now exposes both a 6.09 +/- 1.43 zJ room-temperature five-trial average and a 4.2 +/- 0.9 zJ temperature-series mean
candidate_alternate_source_identity.claim_boundary: A candidate Hong 2016 source record is now staged locally and a primary-facing preprint precursor surface is now visible, but final-source capture and runtime-target selection are still open.

next_controller.why: The runtime row should not be reassigned from Jun to Hong just from year/narrative fit. The Hong source family now has multiple primary-facing numeric candidates, so the repo must first decide which Hong statistic is actually intended before any reassignment decision.

supports: The current Jun source-facing summary is kT-based rather than an archived 0.028 eV row.
The legacy runtime wording includes both 0.028 eV and 44% above limit.
The legacy run-contract wording explicitly labels the point as Experimental (2016).
A secondary-confirmed Hong 2016 nanomagnetic-memory source identity now exists locally as a separate candidate branch.
An accessible same-author preprint precursor now exposes Hong-side numeric candidates closer to the 2016 narrative than the current pinned Jun quantity does.
does_not_support: A closed reassignment of the runtime row to Hong 2016 without a primary source package.
A restored clean mapping of the runtime row to Jun 2014.

minimum_missing_evidence: exact upstream paper identity for the 0.028 eV branch
unit basis and conversion path into the runtime eV row
source-backed uncertainty attached to the same quantity
workflow-file update reflecting the closed lineage decision
allowed_claim_while_open: The 0.028 eV row may remain only as a mixed-lineage lower-bound context value.
claim_boundary: This artifact narrows a provenance blocker. It does not by itself close Jun 2014, establish Hong 2016, or upgrade the UET bridge.
